english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people doing something together and can also mean being in a relationship in the right context.
This is the all-purpose choice when people do something together, as in singing along.
Use this when people or things do something together at the same time, especially in casual speech.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1

examples.english: We simultaneously went out for dinner after work.
examples.traditional: 放工後我哋一齊去食飯。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6
